|game_text=Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date; the image may be older). It prints word for word the text of [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (the original). It is listed as its own version (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The current text is [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''Original''' ([[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 83. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-83-AT_AT_Cannon.png]]) prints slip number “83” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “If just lost from table” to “If lost from table”: “Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.”.<ref name="cl-1220_83-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-atatcannon-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/atatcannon.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual2-Dark], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock2-Dark/large/atatcannon.gif</ref>: “Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “83” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 58), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current).
